# `vars`

Game variables are named numbers that hold puzzle and progress state. `Interactable` conditions test them (`AtLeast`, `Below`, `Equals`) and its actions change them (`AddVar`, `SetVar`), so most puzzles need no script; scripts read and change the same values, and hear about changes:

```lua
    vars.on_change("offerings", function(change)
        self.offerings = change.value
    end)
```

## `vars`

Game variables: named numbers for puzzle and progress state (`embers`, `gate_open`), shared with `Interactable` conditions and actions, kept across scene switches and saved in save games. Unset names read 0.

### `vars.get`

```luau
function vars.get(name: string): number
```

The value of `name` (0 when unset).

### `vars.set`

```luau
function vars.set(name: string, value: number)
```

Sets `name` to `value`.

### `vars.add`

```luau
function vars.add(name: string, amount: number): number
```

Adds `amount` (negative: subtracts) to `name` and returns the new value.

### `vars.all`

```luau
function vars.all(): { [string]: number }
```

Every variable that was set, by name.

### `vars.on_change`

```luau
function vars.on_change(name: string, handler: (change: VarChange) -> ()): number
```

Calls `handler` in the next Update after `name` changes (by a script, an `Interactable` or a loaded save). Returns an id for `vars.off`; removed with the script.

### `vars.off`

```luau
function vars.off(id: number)
```

Removes an `on_change` handler.
